body.long:
US tech enterpreneur Govil eyes purchase of BBL team
Renegades and Hurricanes are among the teams that interest Govil, who already owns or co-owns teams in MLC and the Hundred
Tristan LavalettePublished: Oct 17, 2026, 7:40 AM (4 hrs ago)
Sanjay Govil, an American tech entrepreneur, hopes to purchase a BBL club at a 50% stake or 100% outright as he attempts to build a portfolio of T20 franchise teams that "AI cannot replace in the future".
After months of fierce debate, Cricket Australia last month approved the privatisation of the BBL with the first phase of Melbourne Renegades' sales process having begun.
CA, Cricket Victoria (CV), and their consultant Raine Group, have formally invited expressions of interest in purchasing 100%. Several IPL owners are likely to be involved with hopes of a preferred owner identified by the start of the BBL 2026-27 season on December 12.
Clubs sold at 100% will mean they are owned entirely by the investor who would run their entire operations.
